message: 憧れと目標
And so, my training sessions with Shio-chan continued for a while.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, that's it for today」

name: Shio
message: 「Thank you kindly for your hard work!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whew... You're getting stronger and stronger, Shio-chan. Even Paqy doesn't stand a chance」

name: Paqy
message: 「Why do I gotta go through this...」

name: Shio
message: 「This is \{solely|ひとえ} thanks to the cooperation of Sir Synn and Sir Paqy. I am deeply grateful」

name: Shio
message: 「By the by, Sir Synn. Were we able to avoid everyone's notice today as well?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, we're fine」

name: Shio
message: 「...You have my deepest gratitude」

name: Shio
message: 「Time and time again... Not only do I trouble you during this busy period, you have even indulged my request to keep this a secret」

name: Synn
message: 「It's totally fine, don't worry about it」
Shio-chan's just as competitive as Misa, after all.
She probably doesn't want everyone else to see her weak side.
Still, since she's letting me see it... does that mean I'm at least a little bit special to Shio-chan?

name: Shio
message: 「However, despite taking up your precious time, Sir Synn, I...」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine. Honestly, I'm mostly coming here because I want to see you, Shio-chan」
The words just slipped out. If not for an excuse like this, I'd never get to be alone with Shio-chan.
The moment I realized what I'd said, though, embarrassment hit me all at once.
It seemed Shio-chan felt the exact same way.

name: Shio
message: 「I-I know not whether to feel grateful or bashful...\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry!」

name: Shio
message: 「Yet I... though I have not forgotten a maiden's heart, I fail to conduct myself in a manner befitting one...」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's not true at all!」
I already knew full well that Shio-chan was a girl from when I touched her directly before.
We're dead serious during special training, yet the moment we start talking like this, my heart rate shoots right up.
She's reckless and tomboyish, sure, but her solemn, deeply courteous side is undeniably girlish.
Like the nape of her neck peeking out when her hair sways, her long, slender legs, and her trim, narrow waist.
And her soft, translucent skin...
Wait, no, no, snap out of it!

name: Shio
message: 「By comparison, Sir Synn, one might call you the very paragon of manhood」

name: Synn
message: 「People often say I look girlish, though」

name: Shio
message: 「That is not so! Your physique, your strength of arm. And a willpower as resolute as the 'core' in your name... In every respect, you are a most exemplary personage」

name: Shio
message: 「Truly a presence worthy of the vessel of Student Council President」

name: Synn
message: 「C-Come on... You're exaggerating\s02」

name: Shio
message: 「Excelling in both literary and martial arts, you manage your daily Student Council duties, and even accompany this humble one in training...」

name: Shio
message: 「Could this humble one... also become like Lord Synn...?」

name: Synn
message: 「You know, that... feels kind of like how I used to want to become a Student Council President like Ria-senpai」

name: Shio
message: 「What...!」

name: Synn
message: 「In the end, though, I realized the best answer was for me to become a Student Council President in my own way」

name: Synn
message: 「So, rather than trying to become me, Shio-chan, I think it's better if you work hard to elevate yourself even higher」

name: Synn
message: 「I guess I only came to understand things like that after spending time with everyone on the Student Council...」

name: Shio
message: 「The Student Council... is it...」

name: Shio
message: 「Could this humble one... also become an officer of the Student Council?」

name: Synn
message: 「Rather than worrying about whether you can, isn't it best to just work hard so that you can?」

name: Shio
message: 「Take action before agonizing over it... That is completely true indeed!!」

name: Shio
message: 「This humble one can never thank Lord Synn enough... Here, I must devise a way to repay this debt in a womanly manner!」
